merge_basis: Candidate covers Zongertinib in gastric cancer 2L (Beamion Gastric-1, 1479-0013), a distinct indication and study number from all existing groups: G0005 is Zongertinib 1L NSCLC NDA, G0011 is Zongertinib IIS NSCLC, and G0012 is Zongertinib breast cancer 2L (1479-0017). Different indication and trial number require a new group.
